description: Min USD $17.60/Hr. Max USD $28.15/Hr. Overview Provide direct patient care under the supervision and guidance of the Registered Nurse to an assigned group of patients. Assist as a team member to provide direct care to all patients in the emergency department including all age groups. Nursing Care is provided in accordance with established standards, policies, procedures, protocols and guidelines. Transports medications as requested from the Pharmacy to the nursing unit. title: Senior END Technician
description: Min USD $29.44/Hr. Max USD $45.64/Hr. Overview Under general direction of the lab coordinator, independently performs END procedures in the laboratory, at the bedside, in critical care units and in the operating room on all ages of patients served by the department. The Senior Technologist performs complex patient examinations requiring extensive computer interaction and/or computation of recorded data, and provides technical descriptions of data.
